findings.classification: confirmed gate-coverage gap; owner repair delegated
findings.detail: Gate compiles/runs generated artifacts directly. It never invokes scripts/run-c.py and originally omitted that adapter from record.inputs, so an adapter regression can escape the gate. Parent delegated adapter success/unknown-export/missing-file/bad-C probes and hashing to gate owner. This review has not yet verified that follow-up.

findings.classification: future-profile integration risk; not current defect
findings.detail: Expression fallback reports Internal expression-node. All current remaining Term forms are internal Branch/Sequence traversal containers, so this is correct for current checked core. Every subsequently added source expression form must receive explicit lowering or Unsupported classification when merged; generic fallback cannot be left to misclassify new supported core forms.

review.current_emitter_defects: No concrete current semantic or UB defect found in the bounded review. This is not a general correctness proof.
inspected_invariants: Arguments are staged left to right before cell allocation or any tail parameter write.
Tail rebinding preserves erased parameter indices and assigns every live parameter before goto.
All types with any declared fields are boxed, including erased-only and tag-only constructors.
Erased arguments, lets, and pattern fields produce no computation/slot.
Live stores and loads use declaration-order offsets and union members selected by resolved field type.
Array and stack guards precede emitted writes/body work under their state invariants.
Input dispatch validates names, live arity and per-type enum ordinal bounds.

review.proof_boundary: Eight helper equations are appropriately bounded; no general compiler-refinement, memory-safety, or physical-stack-bound theorem established. The conservative frame-charge and depth probes qualify the recorded normal main-thread host contract only; reduced OS stacks and other compilers/flags require separate evidence.
review.constraints: BEND_NO_TELEMETRY=1; Bun invoked with --no-env-file; no network, .env reads, paid/live Perch, source edits, or tracked receipt changes by reviewer.

integration_note: The adapter gap is addressed by hashed scripts/run-c.py and four fixed probes in host-expectations.json. The final C gate must pass before handoff. Future core expressions require explicit lowering or Unsupported during integration.
